title: Random-example cost bound
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb{N}$ and let the accuracy parameter $\varepsilon$ be rational with $0\leq\varepsilon\leq\tfrac12$. Define $T_0=1$ and $T_{j+1}=1+2T_j$, and set $c=\lfloor 3k/4\rfloor$, $L=\lceil\log_2 T_k\rceil+2(c+1)+5$, and $C=(c+1)36\cdot 4^k L$. The low-degree junta learning algorithm's random-example cost at accuracy $\varepsilon$ is at most $4T_k C(n+1)^{c+3}$.
